purpose: Structured internal claim-to-source map. It remains an internal control layer; the public site presents sources contextually rather than as a separate audit page.
rules: A source ID is not proof by itself; the linked source must support the specific claim.
Historical role descriptions are date-bound and must not be reused as current-role evidence.
Pending or metadata-only material is retained but not promoted to verified evidence.
Primary church records receive priority for current institutional facts and episcopal appointments.
A cross-supported claim must not depend on a pending or uninspected source.
A source that is useful for context is not automatically evidence for a person's individual action or attendance.
Supplemental source ledgers are valid inputs to validation before they are merged into the canonical build output.
